claims.claim: **COVID-19 is generally milder in children than in adults.** Whether it is suspected or confirmed, give the child appropriate respiratory support.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **High-flow oxygen or nebulised therapy: maintain airborne precautions** and manage in the highest level of isolation available.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **COVID-19 may be incidental** — prioritise the child's presenting clinical syndrome.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Isolate in the highest level available** — ideally a single room, negative pressure where possible.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Risk factors for severe disease:** immunosuppression, severe or complex chronic disease, obesity, pregnancy, and age — **under 3 months corrected age, and adolescents**.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Escalate for tachycardia or tachypnoea persistently breaching early-warning or pre-MET limits.** Disease may be severe without deranged vital signs.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Signs of severe illness:** altered mental state · marked tachycardia · severe respiratory distress · cyanosis or severe hypoxaemia.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Keep a low threshold to look for complications** (myocarditis/chest pain, respiratory, neurological) and progression.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Swab every child who meets current testing criteria**; consider re-testing if the child deteriorates and suspicion stays high.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Do not swab a child with croup or suspected upper airway obstruction** until a senior clinician deems it safe.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Mild to moderate disease:** manage as per the clinical syndrome; decide on admission from the clinical assessment (risk factors included), the phase of illness, and social and geographical factors. **Airborne precautions for all HCWs.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Severe disease:** give whatever respiratory support is needed. **High-flow nasal oxygen is acceptable with airborne precautions**; discuss with a senior clinician and consult ICU/Retrieval.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Reserve nebulised adrenaline for severe croup** because of aerosolisation risk.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Additional treatments are for very-high-risk children, moderate to severe disease, or PIMS-TS — never without consulting Infectious Diseases or a senior clinician.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Corticosteroids for children needing ongoing supplemental oxygen** (including ventilated): **dexamethasone 0.15 mg/kg/day IV or oral, max 6 mg.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **VTE prophylaxis:** for hospitalised children, follow local thromboprophylaxis guidelines and consult haematology. **IVIG** is for PIMS-TS; other immunomodulators (anti-IL-1, anti-IL-6, anti-TNF) are third-line for PIMS-TS.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Not recommended:** vitamin D, ivermectin, hydroxychloroquine, colchicine or azithromycin — no supporting evidence.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Myocarditis and pericarditis are associated with mRNA COVID-19 vaccines** — rare, more frequent **after the 2nd dose and in adolescent males**, mostly **within 7 days** but reported up to 14 days.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **An adolescent with palpitations, chest pain, dizziness, syncope or shortness of breath 1 to 14 days after an mRNA COVID-19 vaccine** needs thorough evaluation. Report any adverse event after vaccination.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Consult the paediatric team** for any case needing respiratory or ongoing hydration support; **ICU/Retrieval** for escalating respiratory support; **Infectious Diseases** for severe disease, ongoing respiratory support or PIMS-TS.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Consider discharge** for cases that need no hydration or respiratory support.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **PIMS-TS is a very rare, serious complication 2–6 weeks after SARS-CoV-2 infection** (which may have been asymptomatic). **Consider it in an unwell child with fever (3 days or more), shock, rash and abdominal pain**; it overlaps with Kawasaki disease and toxic shock syndrome.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Discuss every suspected PIMS-TS case urgently with a senior clinician**; tertiary ICU transfer may be needed. With Infectious Diseases consider corticosteroids, IVIG and low-dose aspirin.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'COVID-19' (Last updated September 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/COVID-19/, retrieved 2026-09-23
